metadata.source_authority: Republic of Uganda (Laws of Uganda revised-edition volume)
metadata.source_note: National Social Security Fund Act (Chapter 230) sections 10-12 from the Fund's hosted scan of the Laws of Uganda revised-edition volume pages (running heads "[Cap. 230", volume pagination 8208 onward; OCR at 300 dpi). Section 10: standard contribution of fifteen percent of monthly total wages paid by the contributing employer; section 11: the employer may deduct the employee's share of five percent; section 12: special contribution of ten percent for excepted employees. The rates are original Act 8 of 1985 text, unchanged by the NSSF (Amendment) Act 2021 (print held for diligence; it modernises definitions, membership and voluntary contributions only).
metadata.title: National Social Security Fund Act (Cap. 230) — standard, employee-share and special contributions (ss. 10-12)
metadata.transcription_note: OCR misreads are corrected to the printed text, checked on the page images. The scan is cut at the right margin of volume pages 8215 and 8217, and eleven line-final words are editorial restorations: s.10(6) "an", "her", "wages", "as"; s.11(1) "wage", "contribution", "that", "month,"; s.12(1) "that", "respect", "by". Eight follow from the visible letters and the grammar. Three are not observable in this print and are corroborated by the Laws of Uganda 2000 revised edition (Cap. 222) as consolidated by Laws.Africa: the plural "wages" (Cap. 222 s.11(6)), "that" in "to that employee" and the comma in "any month," (Cap. 222 s.12(1)), at https://media.ulii.org/media/legislation/18538/source_file/e8d418f126b5c47a/1985-8.pdf (retrieved 2026-09-25, sha256 efeb3198e5fe7f4fb571a00facc8500190c1e49bb507f971eec3637cf1a42fa4, PDF page 9). Running heads are dropped, and section 12 ends before section 13.
